Root read ACTUAL14c7c936e056c685e85ee8f34f6185aa27ed9a2c/review.json and verified exactDocs42124324426/head/ref/alljobsSUCCESS. 2a08 remains REVISION REQUIRED B4-M1/M2 and L1-L4; no partialfreeze/registration/B code grant. Prior approvalrenewal/gate-delivery/scope and B3L1/L2/L4/L5 directions close at DESIGN level. Root also read actual72028 build_execution286-310, node_transport234-253, node_channels150-233, src/saintvision/services/nodes enroll/lost, storage create/activate/revoke. These are real writer/ownership/permission gaps, not new user approval. AUTHORIZE ONE narrow REV5 DOCS/schema/static/source-analysis delta under same owner, preserve2a08/e993/actualreviews/probes. No product/PG/Node/key/VM/physical changes.
M1 ROOT CHOOSES complete source-writer->procedure reconciliation AND no direct authority DML escape through a legacy online pool. Define typed map for EVERY actual SQL/ORM writer on each matrix table: exact source SHA/path/function/line/expression/verbs/columns, actual caller/principal/pool, B replacement procedure(s), allowed transition predicate, lock entry plan/evidence/transaction boundary. Retired callsites name exact supported replacement. New/unmapped writer or removed mapping must fail a semantic census<->matrix audit, not only full golden JSON equality. inv.evidence is append-only DATA/EVIDENCE, not an approval factory; other authority columns have explicit ownership. Do not keep broad legacy DML on shared B-authority tables to make plain APIs work.
Future rollout will mediate SHARED authority-table writes for plain AND B online services through named fixed-scope procedures; no online legacy inv_kernel/app SETROLE/direct-DML bypass on those shared tables. Existing plain external semantics/owner permissions/one-time-bootstrap consumption must be preserved through plain-specific procedure wrappers whose actual DB truth selects the applicable profile. No request flag selects a weaker plain path for a B member. This is an explicit FUTURE migration/refactor obligation and no direct privilege changes now. Product-code scope/PG tests for both paths will be assigned after actual design acceptance; do not pretend current72028 already uses these wrappers.
REQUIRED mappings: (a) runtime fail-closed quarantine in build_execution304 and node_transport247 -> narrow one-way b_raise_node_quarantine (or exact equivalent), EXECUTE allowed only authenticated runtime/verifier/safety for ownedtenant/Node/epoch/currentoperation plus causal diagnostic/evidence. It may raise scheduling denial and append reconciliation/outbox obligation; it cannot clear quarantine/containment, freeclaims or claim physicalstop/success. Losing quarantine permission cannot roll back the safety decision into healthy eligibility. Node/claims outcome remains actual journal+receipt governed.
(b) node_channels.provision_channel is already trustedoperator-only: preserve protected INSERT/upsert/audit/DER/identity/epoch/expectedC CAS and map exact operator procedure, not b_member_cas pretending it covers initial provision. revoke_channel needs explicit protected/narrow authorized revocation procedure with enabled=false/sharedC+1/audit, never re-enable/reset/replacecertificate or independentstoragecounter. Revoke/mixedC consequences stay priorquarantine/recovery gates, no ordinary renew frominvalidstate.
(c) ALL5 inv.evidence INSERT sites build_execution666/results219/runs180/shard_completion142/storage_commit327 map to fixed typed append/commit procedures/principals matching their ORIGINAL nonce/run/receipt/claim atomicity. Either separate named writers or a closed kind->caller->columns map; an arbitrary-evidence JSON bag cannot mint authority or positive outcome. Each actualsite must have a mapping and negative.
(d) public.nodes enroll INSERT, certificate binding, heartbeat/loss and retirement are distinct authority/identity transitions. Dedicated enrollment/operator paths preserve exact authenticated one-use bootstrap semantics and cannot create a new B identity to bypass a quarantined/partial existingcohort. Certificate fingerprint changes only protected exact approved enrollment/leafCAS under existingidentity/epoch/sharedC; ordinary heartbeat never replacescert. Online liveness procedures can change only permitted telemetry/sequence/time and source-defined active<->lost or inv online<->offline with authenticated freshNode observations, NEVER clear quarantined/draining/retired/operatorcontainment. Retirement/revocation is terminal except separate reviewed recovery/re-enrollment gate. Explicitcolumn+from/to predicate is authoritative; generic status='online' input is not.
(e) public.storage_contributions CREATE/PENDING/ACTIVATE/REVOKE/status/revoked_at all mapped. Preserve REAL card250 Node-owner boundary: registered_by_user_id/actual folder-owner authorization, not projectgrade or a generic OP impersonating the owner. Owner can withdraw/revoke terminally; catalogue/folder retained, no deletion or unreviewed reactivation. Activation requires its original Node folder confirmation+ownership, and is STILL NOT B role/storage admission. B exactRO/root/R/policy/wholeprofile protected approval is additional, not a substitute for ownerconsent. Revocation blocks affected B use/currenteligibility through defined status/authority conditions, no policy regeneration/R/C reset or automatic compute-only downgrade. Historical frozen references remain.
Status shared columns need semantic invariants: observation can only toggle ordinary online/offline (or public active/lost) WHEN no containment/retirement holds; safety can only increase denial; only explicitly protected reviewed clear/restore can reduce denial with required proofs. Model effective eligibility as conjunction of independentvalidauthority/currentchain/status/containment, never an online observation clearing protected state. Map every writer including new B procedures, operator wrappers and ORM lifecycle to these conditions.
M2 ROOT CHOOSES actual closure seeds from EVERY canonical/matrix row-locking record, plus helper reachability; not helper-only. Constructor-typed X(...).m, v=X(...);v.m, self/import/module/dottedaliases and SQL string constants must resolve to source edges/tables/modes or be explicit UNKNOWN/BLOCK edges (never dropped). Include actual24 dropped receiver calls, all18 unplanned canonical lockers incl build_preparations._terminalize736-752, build_execution_worker enqueue212, NodePrincipal.lock_current108, observation/channel/quarantine/model/source/storage/settings/views. Per-function plans name actual discovered Node/resource set, actual locks/modes/ranks, outer tx owner, authoritative rechecks and externalI/O boundary; constants shared boilerplate are not a concrete plan.
Explicit canonical B rank order: control_epoch -> tenant_controls -> routing/fence -> sorted transaction advisory keys -> sorted inv.nodes -> sorted public.nodes -> contributions -> node_channels -> role/current -> inv.projects -> project_resource_limits -> storage_budgets -> shard_plans -> approval_requests -> runs -> operator_grants -> other named resource/claim/transfer/model/terminal rows -> nonce/evidence/ledger/audit. Refine remaining classes explicitly; no unrankedlocked table silently MVCC. Late-discovered earlier-rank set aborts/replans without authority/effects. Original Run-before-Node and parent/approvalbudget inversions must be replaced, not blessed. Existing bootstrap/offline maintenance advisory locks are separately scoped phases with no concurrentB traffic; label them and actual prerequisites rather than pretending all app paths are liveBcanonical. Other advisory users take exact canonical rank and sortednamespace/keys.
Recognize SQL FOR NO KEY UPDATE, FOR SHARE/KEY SHARE, ORM with_for_update= kwargs/read/key_share/skip_locked/nowait and transaction advisory locks as distinct modes/modifiers. Where semantics depend on SQLAlchemy flags, compile representative expressions with PINNED SQLAlchemy PostgreSQL dialect in isolated fixture (no app import/DB) to show actual SQL; don't guess every variant UPDATE/MVCC. Advisory isn't MVCC and has its own key order. Include implicitFK/RLS assets and externaltransaction nesting, actual future PG lock traces remainPENDING.
Make negatives SOURCE-LEVEL: mutate ephemeral/in-memory source Gitbytes and regenerate; assert semantic record/scope/edge/mode/plan detection, not just scannedFileshashdiff or storedJSON !=self. Reproduce reviewer S4 dottedimport/S5instancewrapper/S6SQLconstant plus known directlocker/mode cases. Preserve earlier JSON-comparator tests as comparator-only historical proof; don't relabel them source mutations. Undefined receiver can be UNKNOWN with implementation BLOCK, but required knownpath must have a concrete supported plan, not globalBdenial.
L1 CHOOSE lineage-inherited revocation. NewApproval's immutable prior chain/rootLineageID must be authenticated. Explicit revocation of ANY ancestor denies all descendants for append/ARM/activation/delivery/REFRESH/token issuance/currentuse gates; expiry of an OLD ancestor alone does NOT expire a legitimately newer approval. Persist protected lineage revocation/tombstone/current-state proof and recheck at every commit boundary; omitted ancestor isn't 'unrevoked'. A1append->revokeA0->activateA1 MUSTdeny. No sameconfig reapprove bypass; revokedlineage needs separate reviewed recovery/newauthority. CPdenial immediate, Node enforcement remains acknowledged durable gate invalidation or token/delegation bounds; don't invent instantremote revocation.
L2 CHOOSE durable monotonic Node gate history. INVALIDATED gateIDs AND their releases terminal for thatNode/generation; cannot ARM retired g0/release again afterg1, even a freshly signed valid command. Release.generation MUSTequal measured currentgeneration atARM, plus exactexpectedpriorrecord/version/hash and currentapprovedtuple. NewARMuses freshgateID/newallowedrelease and monotonic durable recordsequence; no epoch/C/R reset. Exact duplicatecommand may return originalrecordedack only without a mutation while stillconsistent; cannot resurrect afterinvalidated/restart. Persist state/retiredIDs/commandbinding before acknowledging. Test A4/A5 plus consistentcounterfactualcontexts.
For lost/stale ACK add OBSERVE-lane exact authenticated /v1/roles/observe read of current durable gaterecord, recorded originaltransitionack if present, commandhash/state/generation/sequence/tombstone/nonce/freshNode-signedreadback. This read grants no business and uses existingCPmTLS/controlpeer/epoch, not expired business token. If originalACK exists, is stillvalid, matches exactintent and freshreadback proves same currenttransition, record resolvedoutcome without re-executingARM. If originalACK absent/stale or conflicting and normaltransitionproof cannot be satisfied, remainfenced/UNKNOWN and explicitly enter B-RECOVERY1; do NOT silently recreate an oldACK withnewtime, re-armoldrelease, resetgate or startnewordinaryrenew. Choose this explicit HOLD boundary rather than an unspecified automatic freshgate recovery; a future protected recovery may invalidate exactstate then use a NEWrelease/gate under separatelyreviewed authority. Define refusal/expiredreadback schemas and statefultests for lossexact/stale>60s/restart/conflict. Observedrecord alone is not positiveactivation/keydelivery authority.
L3 CHOOSE purpose-restricted SIGNING SERVICE with the existing protectedoperatorrelease verification anchor (no newdeliverykey). sv_b_delivery_controller DOES NOT possess raw operatorrelease privatekey. It can call only authenticated service purposes KEY_DELIVERY_PREPARE and KEY_DELIVERY_RECEIPT with validated exactpostcommitledger/currentARM/key/recipient/challenge scope. Server-side calleridentity->purpose/domain/scope allowlist is installedprotectedpolicy, not callerrolelabel, and denies controller APPROVAL/RELEASE/DELEGATION/GATE_CONTROL requests BEFOREsigning. Operator's approvedpurposes separatelylisted. Runtime/useissuer/safety/budget roles cannot impersonatecontroller/operator. DBEXECUTE separation alone is insufficient; model signeraccess too. Add controlleraskingAPPROVAL/GATE negatives, preserve separatebudgetkey/purpose and actualcustodyNULL.
L4 keep goldenmanifest fidelity checks but ADD actualsemantic invariants: onlineordinaryprincipal no protectedprocedure, containment-clear columns only authorizedOP/SAFEas scoped (runtimeonewayquarantine is DENY-only), everytable ALLactualwriters mapped or explicitlegitimate-none, read/lockprocedures notwritegrants, ownerstorage rights intact, no runtimeSETROLEescape. Per-oneOf-branch ObservationScope missingfield/extra/type/refusalpayload negatives. Use TIME-ADVANCING phase trace (append, invalidate,ARM,CAS,delivery) for expiry mid-switch, staleACK>60s, fence/revocation afterappend, lostresponse resolved vsunknown; not allNowconstant. Publish small unique rev5 source-writer/matrix/transition/census/closedreadback/signercapability/temporalfixture delta with allpriorerrors preserved and actual8gates/normalcommit/push/exactDocs.
